name: GetServiceNowTableRecord
label: Get ServiceNow Table Record
description: Retrieves a specific record from a ServiceNow table by sys_id using a stored credential.

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential
fields.description: The stored ServiceNow credential (Base64 token or OAuth2 token)

fields.name: TableName
fields.label: Table Name or ID
fields.description: Name or sys_id of the ServiceNow table (e.g., incident, change_request, problem)

fields.name: RecordId
fields.label: Table Record ID
fields.description: The sys_id of the record to retrieve

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from ServiceNow API

fields.name: Record
fields.label: Record
fields.description: The retrieved record as JObject (contains sys_id, number, etc.)
